_: Copy changes for shared web files whose build markers belong to another area. Each rule: find (exact text) or pattern (a regular expression), replace, min/max matches (a rule outside its range fails the build), why. Better: /*@web*/ and /*@ios*/ regions in the file itself; then delete the rule here (it will stop matching and fail the build as a reminder). Since the plans decision of 30 Oct 2026 these rules are about one thing: what the account screens say about Apple subscriptions (App Review 3.1.1, 5.1.1(v)).

cybernet-privacy-controls.js.find: To cancel a paid plan and keep your account, use Manage Billing on the Account Info tab.
cybernet-privacy-controls.js.replace: To cancel an App Store subscription and keep your account, use Manage subscription in Account.
cybernet-privacy-controls.js.why: the website's panel sends people to Manage Billing, which the app does not have; the app's Account screen has Manage subscription (Apple's sheet)
the refusal button must not name a billing page; in the app it opens Apple's Manage Subscriptions sheet (cybernet-privacy-controls.js openBilling, @ios)

cybernet-privacy-controls.js.find: • Any paid plan (Pro, or a Business team you own): it is cancelled immediately
cybernet-privacy-controls.js.replace: • Any plan bought outside the app: it is cancelled immediately. A subscription bought in the app is not cancelled by this.
cybernet-privacy-controls.js.why: owner decision 30 Oct 2026: deleting the account cancels a website plan but cannot cancel an App Store subscription (Apple does that)

cybernet-privacy-controls.js.find: Paying for Pro or Business? Deleting your account cancels the plan immediately. Paid access ends now and there is no refund for the rest of the billing period. To keep it until the period ends, cancel in Manage Billing instead and delete your account after that date. Anything saved in this browser is cleared too.
cybernet-privacy-controls.js.replace: Subscribed through the App Store? Deleting your account does not cancel an App Store subscription. Cancel it first in Settings > your name > Subscriptions, or Apple keeps charging you.
cybernet-privacy-controls.js.why: the warning App Review 5.1.1(v) and common sense need next to Delete; the button (shown for an Apple-billed plan) opens Apple's sheet

cybernet-privacy-controls.js.find: that Stripe must keep by law
cybernet-privacy-controls.js.replace: that our payment provider must keep by law
cybernet-privacy-controls.js.why: the app's screens do not name the website's payment processor (the in-app Privacy Policy does, as a processor of the website)

cybernet-privacy-controls.js.find: You can still use Quick Scan without an account.
cybernet-privacy-controls.js.replace: You can still use Quick Scan without an account. If you subscribed through the App Store, cancel the subscription in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. Deleting your account does not stop Apple charging you.
cybernet-privacy-controls.js.why: the notice after a deletion repeats the one thing the person must still do
